limitations: The result proves the consecutive-ratio conjecture only in the boundary range \(n\ge 3k^2\) and for the complete fixed case \(k\le3\); it does not resolve deeper ranks and does not optimize the constant 3. The motivating conjecture is very recent, so unindexed parallel work remains a residual originality risk.
record_title: A square-root boundary layer for the consecutive spanning-forest ratio conjecture
